To calculate $17 \times 23$, we can use the standard multiplication algorithm or break it down using the distributive property.

**Method: Distributive Property**
We can split 23 into $20 + 3$:
$$17 \times 23 = 17 \times (20 + 3)$$
$$= (17 \times 20) + (17 \times 3)$$

1.  Calculate $17 \times 20$:
    $$17 \times 2 = 34$$
    $$34 \times 10 = 340$$

2.  Calculate $17 \times 3$:
    $$10 \times 3 = 30$$
    $$7 \times 3 = 21$$
    $$30 + 21 = 51$$

3.  Add the results:
    $$340 + 51 = 391$$

**Final Answer:**
391
